technique_name: Explain the importance of analytics in business decisions.
description: Analytics is essential for success in today’s business world, as it helps decision-makers understand customer and business trends, identify opportunities, and make more informed decisions. Using analytics, businesses can track customer behaviors and patterns, measure marketing performance, and identify sales cycles.
